translations.JSON-encoded array of StatusTransition o: JSON-encoded array of StatusTransition objects. Each transition has: id (UUID), fromStatus (UUID), toStatus (UUID), label (string), guards (array of Guard), automaticActions (array of ActionRef), allowedRoles (array of UUID. Legacy, normalised on read to routingRule.or-set), routingRule (optional object same shape as workflowStep.routingRule). Guard types: checklist, requiredField, requiredDocument, roleGuard. Action types: sendEmail, createTask, createSubCase, webhook, setField, notify. V1.3 additive, three declarations a transition may carry, all optional and absent on every template shipped before them (see what-a-transition-declares). `requiresSettled`: an array of dependencies that must be settled before the transition is AVAILABLE. Each entry is {kind, obligationKind?, field?, value?, documentType?, label?} with kind one of obligationOpen, fieldPresent, fieldEquals or documentPresent. An unsettled dependency WITHHOLDS the transition rather than refusing it afterwards, and the reason is published where the transition would have been. The last three kinds are the same vocabulary statusType.derivedWhen uses, so an author who has written one has written the other. `explanation`: the sentence an administrator writes for the handler, rendered at the moment of choosing rather than after the move. An empty explanation renders nothing. `notPerformedBy`: {act, askInstead?}, naming the LABEL of an earlier transition whose performer may not make this one. A negative rule about an act, not a role: the same person legitimately approves other cases they did not prepare. The engine reads the performer from the case status record chain.
translations.JSON-encoded array of WorkflowStep objec: JSON-encoded array of WorkflowStep objects. Each step has: id (UUID), title, description, status (UUID ref to statusType), order (integer), assigneeRole (UUID ref to roleType, optional. Legacy, normalised on read to routingRule.single-role), routingRule (optional object {strategy: single-role|or-set|hierarchical|round-robin|least-loaded, roleType: UUID, roleTypes: [UUID], fallback: UUID}), isRequired (boolean), checklist (array of {id, label, description}), automaticActions (array of ActionRef). V1.1 additive: optional `config` sub-object = {sla:{value:int 1-10000, unit:hours|businessDays|calendarDays}, requiredFields:string[] (case-field property paths), autoActions:ActionRef[] fired before transition-level actions on step completion, escalationRule:{trigger:preBreach|slaBreached, offset:int, offsetUnit:hours|businessDays, notifyRole:UUID, escalateToRole:UUID, openIncident:boolean}. Requires sla present; preBreach offset must be <= sla.value}. Absent config preserves v1 behaviour. V1.2 additive: optional `task` sub-object = the one declaration block for the task this step creates. {enabled:boolean (default true; false means this case type does not run the task at all), leadTimeDays:int (the task's OWN due date, counted in working days from the day it is created, rather than the case deadline), candidateGroups:string[] and candidateUsers:string[] (who the task is offered to before it is assigned; the engine's claim verb is what turns one of them into its assignee), form:{kind:fields|external, schema, fields:[{field,required}], formId, requireChecklist} (written verbatim onto the engine task's metadata.form, which OpenRegister's task form resolver reads, so there is one form vocabulary and not two), effects:ActionRef[] (what completing the task does, run through ActionHandlerRegistry)}. It is ONE block per task and never several maps keyed by task name: publishing refuses a leadTimeDays, candidateGroups, candidateUsers or effects written beside the block instead of inside it, and refuses a form, group or effect handler that cannot be resolved, naming the task and what was missing.

translations.The condition that clears the marker. Cl: The condition that clears the marker. Clearing is doing the work, never opening the panel, so the only clearing a marker may declare is that the thing that raised it stopped being true.
translations.The condition that raises the marker. A: The condition that raises the marker. A closed list, and a short one on purpose: a condition nothing can evaluate is a marker that never appears and never says why. A marker for a document that failed its virus scan is absent because `scanVerdict` is the open scan-verdict-on-the-row change and no document carries one yet, and a marker for a party whose post came back is absent because a role carries no such field. Both land when the fields do. `aanvullingsverzoek-open` reads the derived flag `aanvullingsverzoek-as-a-record` writes and raises nothing until that change lands, which is declared rather than silent.
translations.The confidentiality level this row grant: The confidentiality level this row grants at. The same vocabulary the case and the case type use, so a row and a case can be compared without a translation table.
translations.The confidentiality levels this mandate: The confidentiality levels this mandate applies at. An AXIS of the declaration, never a role name: folding the level into the role gives a role per level per department, which is the combinatorial explosion every mandate matrix eventually becomes. Empty means every level.

The day the assessment was made.
translations.The day the personal data in this case s: The day the personal data in this case stops having a lawful purpose (AVG art. 5.1e). Counted from the case's end date and the case type's own retention, never from the archive action date. The two clocks disagree on purpose, and a case that carries one date answers whichever question it was built for and gets the other one wrong.
translations.The day this assessment should be looked: The day this assessment should be looked at again. Once it has passed the assessment reads as due for review rather than as current.
translations.The day work on this case is planned to: The day work on this case is planned to start. A case carrying one shows it in the working list, so a handler can see what is coming as well as what is due.
translations.The deadline for objection (until {deadl: The deadline for objection (until {deadline}) has passed. Please contact the municipality for more information.

A list cannot sort on the word: alphabetically high comes before low and urgent comes last of all, which is neither the order a handler means nor a usable one. Written from x-enum-order on the priority property.
translations.The declared rule that last raised this: The declared rule that last raised this case's priority, so a handler can see why a case moved up without anybody touching it.
translations.The default route through this case type: The default route through this case type: the workflow a case follows when it is not given one of its own. A case type may carry several routes, and this names the one new cases take. When unset, a case falls through to the case type's only active workflow. A case keeps the workflow it was bound to, even after a newer version is published (see case.workflowTemplate and case.workflowVersion).
translations.The definition's name, stored beside the: The definition's name, stored beside the value so a case can be read without resolving every definition first

A file here is work in progress, not yet a document on the case: completing the task turns it into a caseDocument recording the task it came from, and removing it while the task is open takes it off again. A samenwerkingsverband grants once on the group and every type in it inherits the grant, so thirty grants that drift become one. translations.The group whose members may abort a case: The group whose members may abort a case of this type. An abort records an intrekking or a niet-ontvankelijkverklaring: there is a result and it is not a besluit. Named separately from finishing because the two are not the same authority.
translations.The group whose members may archive a fi: The group whose members may archive a finished case of this type. Archiving writes the retention rule the result type carries, so it is an archivist's act rather than a handler's. A case type that names no group refuses every archive except an administrator's.
translations.The group whose members may destroy a de: The group whose members may destroy a deleted case of this type. Destroying is a second act after deleting, and it cannot be undone, so the right is named per case type: a melding and a bezwaar do not need the same seniority behind it. A case type that names no group refuses every destruction except an administrator's, which is the same answer OpenRegister's own destroy right gives.
translations.The group whose members may finish a cas: The group whose members may finish a case of this type. Finishing is the act that says the case reached its result, and the result decides what is retained. A case type that names no group lets any handler with access to the case finish it, which is today's behaviour.
translations.The groups and the people that may be ch: The groups and the people that may be chosen as the handler when a case of this type is created. Declaring neither keeps every choice.
translations.The handler who asked. Written from the: The handler who asked. Written from the session rather than offered as a field, so nobody signs somebody else's name to a statutory act.

translations.The lowest number this field accepts. On: The lowest number this field accepts. Only meaningful on a number or integer field.

translations.The machine name a transition names in r: The machine name a transition names in requiresSettled, and the value an obligation of this kind carries.
translations.The Mail app is not installed, so intake: The Mail app is not installed, so intake reads nothing. Your messages stay in the mailbox and none are lost. Install Mail to start reading them.

translations.The manifest page a handler registers a: The manifest page a handler registers a case of this type on. Empty means the standard intake screen.
translations.The markers standing on this case right: The markers standing on this case right now, one per declared condition that is true. Derived on every save from the declarations on the case type, so a marker clears when the condition behind it stops being true and nobody has to dismiss it. Not per user: the per-user badge of unread-state-on-the-case is a different fact and lives beside this one.
translations.The markers the system may raise on a ca: The markers the system may raise on a case of this type. Each one is a PAIR: the condition that raises it and the condition that clears it. Written as code the pair ends up in two files and drifts, so it is declared here where an administrator can read it and a test can check it. A declaration carrying a raise condition and no clear condition is refused on publication, naming the marker.
translations.The message could not be sent. It may be: The message could not be sent. It may be empty or too long.

translations.The messages that go out without anybody: The messages that go out without anybody sending them. A message not named here is not sent for this case type, which is how a type that corresponds on paper stops mailing.
translations.The missing items named in a request to: The missing items named in a request to the applicant, or the ones that came back with the aanvulling. Asking and suspending the term are one act under Awb 4:5, so one record carries what was asked, when it was asked, and the suspension it caused.
The moment this case was declared major.
translations.The moments at which the applicant is to: The moments at which the applicant is told something without a handler acting. The entry for case-received carries the statutory flag and is the Awb 4:3a acknowledgement. Asking the applicant for something is its own moment, distinct from a status change, because informing and chasing are not the same message.
translations.The name above is written for you. Leave: The name above is written for you. Leave these empty and the applicant reads that name.

translations.The named set this role type was shipped: The named set this role type was shipped in, for example gemeentelijke-rollen. Empty means the role was authored here.
translations.The new version keeps the name and the i: The new version keeps the name and the identifier of this one. It copies the statuses, results, attributes and the workflow.

translations.The object this location is taken from,: The object this location is taken from, as the URI the caseObject link holds. translations.The person who held the seat before the: The person who held the seat before the handover.

translations.The phase this clock belongs to. Filled: The phase this clock belongs to. Filled in on a phase term and empty on the other three kinds.

The place this case is about.

The last five values are the ones dossiq used to offer before the vocabulary reached the editor: 'date', 'url' and 'email' are a string with a format, 'enum' is a string with a choice list, and 'json' is an object. They stay accepted so a stored definition keeps working and keeps its value. Nothing rewrites them, the editor offers them only on the definition that already carries one, and each one names its replacement.
translations.What makes this status true. A status th: What makes this status true. A status that declares conditions is DERIVED: the case moves into it as the conditions become true, and it leaves the list of moves a handler picks. A status that declares nothing is a judgment somebody makes, which is most of them. Every condition is written in the vocabulary OpenRegister's lifecycleCondition rule kind uses, so the evaluation is a deletion once that kind lands rather than a rewrite.

What settled it, for the record.
What sort of work the task is.

What the handler is told is outstanding. Write it as the thing itself, not as the rule: "the fire safety inspection" rather than "inspection obligation open".
What the handler reads on the button.

translations.What the handler recorded about this ite: What the handler recorded about this item, for one that arrived incomplete or came with a question.
translations.What the indicator is called on screen a: What the indicator is called on screen and in the refusal that names it.

What the zaaksysteem said went wrong.
translations.What this case holds could not be read,: What this case holds could not be read, so nothing was split.
translations.What this case sent the applicant on its: What this case sent the applicant on its own, one entry per message: the moment, the channel, the recipient and the version of the template it was rendered from. Cluster 23's outbound log renders these rather than keeping a second set.
translations.What this destination is called where a: What this destination is called where a handler reads it.
translations.What this group is for, and who it belon: What this group is for, and who it belongs to.
translations.What this instance still needs before it: What this instance still needs before it can take a case. Nothing here blocks the app: you can leave an item open and carry on.
What this instance still needs before it can take a case. Reported, never required: only the register check blocks the app.
translations.What this marker is called, in one word: What this marker is called, in one word a refusal can name.
translations.What this obligation withholds while it: What this obligation withholds while it is open. Each entry is a statusType uuid, or the token `closing` for every status that closes the case. The TOKEN is what makes a case type with three ways out safe: a list of ids has to be kept complete by hand, and the door somebody forgot is the one the case leaves by. An empty list blocks the closing statuses.
translations.What this organisation assessed the risk: What this organisation assessed the risk on this case to be, on what ground, by whom and when it is due to be looked at again. Available to every domain rather than to VTH alone. A level with no ground is a number nobody can defend or revise, so the ground is part of the assessment rather than an optional note beside it.
translations.What this party's situation refuses. war: What this party's situation refuses. warn shows the reader a notice and blocks nothing; refuse-publication refuses publishing a file on any case this party is on; refuse-send refuses an outbound message to this party. The effect is evaluated where the act happens, not where the chip is drawn.
translations.What this retry failed with, if it faile: What this retry failed with, if it failed.
translations.What this status asks for. Every item be: What this status asks for. Every item becomes a task on the case the moment the case enters this status, created once per status however often the case comes back. An item marked required holds the case in this status until its task is completed, and the transition button says which item is still open.
translations.What this status asks of the case: What this status asks of the case
translations.What this status asks of the case. Publi: What this status asks of the case. Publishing the case type hands these to the platform, which refuses a save that breaks one.
translations.What this status does to the field. requ: What this status does to the field. required: it may not be left empty while the case sits here. hidden: it is kept out of the read and refused on write. readOnly: it is shown and refused on change.
translations.What this status MEANS in a process, ind: What this status MEANS in a process, independent of what it is called. A shipped flow moves a case by role, so it works on a case type that calls its working phase Beoordeling or Onderzoek rather than In behandeling. Leave it empty for a status no flow needs to address.
translations.What this status means in a process. A s: What this status means in a process. A shipped flow moves a case by role, so it also works on a type that calls this phase something else.
translations.What this template is called where a han: What this template is called where a handler picks one. Only read when the row is a template.
translations.What this template makes. The kind decid: What this template makes. The kind decides where it is offered.
translations.What to say when the save is refused: What to say when the save is refused

translations.What you can do with this case: What you can do with this case
translations.What you tick moves to the new case. Thi: What you tick moves to the new case. This case keeps a reference to it, so the file still reads as a whole.
translations.What your team gave itself. The applican: What your team gave itself. The applicant was not told this.
translations.When a case of this type owes the sender: When a case of this type owes the sender an acknowledgement of receipt, and how it is sent. Awb 4:3a owes one to every electronically submitted message, so the default is on and the default channel list is every electronic intake channel. A case typed at the balie owes nothing unless this declaration says so.
translations.When an advisory body exceeds this overd: When an advisory body exceeds this overdue-rate over the trailing 30 days, the bottleneck workflow notifies coordinators.
translations.When heeftAlleAutorisaties is false, aut: When heeftAlleAutorisaties is false, autorisaties must be specified.
translations.When heeftAlleAutorisaties is true, auto: When heeftAlleAutorisaties is true, autorisaties must not be specified. When heeftAlleAutorisaties is false, autorisaties must be specified.
translations.When the action was completed, which is: When the action was completed, which is the date its successor is counted from.
translations.When the adoption was undone. Empty whil: When the adoption was undone. Empty while the set is in use.
translations.When the case entered the status it is i: When the case entered the status it is in now. The engine writes it in the same save as the status, so the dwell is measured from a fact rather than reconstructed from the record chain on every read.
When the condition first became true.
translations.When the draft was begun, kept on the ca: When the draft was begun, kept on the case after it is promoted. When the aanvraag arrived is a fact somebody will ask about, and the promotion moment is not it.
translations.When the grant this row produces stops a: When the grant this row produces stops answering, as an ISO-8601 moment. Optional: a row without it grants without an end. The key is spelled the way OpenRegister reads it (GrantConstraints::UNTIL_KEY, openregister#3750), so no translation stands between the declaration and the rule; a second spelling is where an end quietly stops arriving. OpenRegister reads it at resolution time, so nothing has to run to take the right away, and an end nobody can parse is treated as already passed. dossiq never compares this to a clock: the clock that decides is OpenRegister's.
translations.When the handler recorded the answer as: When the handler recorded the answer as complete.
translations.When the instance already has a row: When the instance already has a row
translations.When the obligation is due, where its ki: When the obligation is due, where its kind declares a term. An obligation past this date is overdue and still blocking: an unmet term does not release the case, it only says the wait has gone on too long.
translations.When the open request was sent, so the w: When the open request was sent, so the work list can show how long this case has been waiting without opening the request. Cleared when the last open request closes.
translations.When the reader opened what they were me: When the reader opened what they were mentioned in; empty while the mention is still waiting
translations.When the request went out. The moment th: When the request went out. The moment the term was suspended from, so it is the record of the Awb 4:5 act.
translations.When the rule applies. Written in the sa: When the rule applies. Written in the same three kinds derivedWhen uses, so a case type has one condition vocabulary rather than two.
translations.When the sender says they sent it: When the sender says they sent it
translations.When the status was last written by a pr: When the status was last written by a probe or a save.
When they put it to sleep.
translations.When this case type was last retired or: When this case type was last retired or restored.
When this change is due to be sent.
translations.Where the connection is configured. Empt: Where the connection is configured. Empty when there is nothing to configure yet.
Where the connection sits in the list.
translations.Where the duty stands: not owed, still b: Where the duty stands: not owed, still being sent, met, or spent every retry without going out.
Where the file can be opened.
translations.Where the request stands. A request that: Where the request stands. A request that was never answered becomes expired and stays: it is the evidence that the applicant was given the chance, which Awb 4:5 requires before an application can be refused for incompleteness.
Where the task is in its lifecycle.
translations.Where this obligation stands. Met and wi: Where this obligation stands. Met and withdrawn both release the case and are never recorded as each other: an inspection nobody carried out is not an inspection that passed, and six months later that difference is the whole record.
translations.Whether a case of this type needs a coor: Whether a case of this type needs a coordinator named before its besluit is signed. The Awb answer is signed by the second seat, and a case type that leaves this off never asks for one: most cases have a handler and nobody else.
translations.Whether a handover of this case is waiti: Whether a handover of this case is waiting for the receiving team to accept it. A projection of the open casetransfer record and never a second custody trail: it exists so the sending team's list can show what it handed on and nobody picked up.
translations.Whether a referenced message id is one t: Whether a referenced message id is one this account really holds. Fail means the reply claim is forged
translations.Whether an aanvullingsverzoek on this ca: Whether an aanvullingsverzoek on this case is still open. A read convenience so the work list can filter and facet without reading every request of every case; the COUNT comes from the requests themselves, so the two cannot drift for long and the requests are the truth (design D-5). Written by the act that asks and by the answer that closes, never derived on an unrelated save: the requests are separate objects and a save that did not read them knows nothing about them. NOT the same fact as `isIncomplete`, which is about required fields a handler knowingly left empty at intake.
translations.Whether any marker is standing on this c: Whether any marker is standing on this case. Derived beside the markers themselves so the work list can facet without reading every marker of every case.
translations.Whether burgers are identified via DigiD: Whether burgers are identified via DigiD (portaal/chat), identificatievragen (telefoon), or both.
translations.Whether cases in this status stay out of: Whether cases in this status stay out of the Cases index. A closed status fills the list with work nobody is doing; marking it hidden keeps it off every lens except Closed. The case carries the flag as the calculated statusHiddenInLists so the list filters it server-side.
translations.Whether cases of this type process perso: Whether cases of this type process personal data. Answer it on the type rather than per case: it is a property of the process, and a case handler is not the person who decides it.
translations.Whether required fields were knowingly l: Whether required fields were knowingly left empty. A phone intake cannot always be complete, and refusing it loses the case; what the case must not do is report itself complete. Acts that need the missing data are refused, naming the field.
translations.Whether the action is still to be done,: Whether the action is still to be done, has been done, or was dropped. Completing one plans its successor; cancelling one ends the chain without planning anything.
translations.Whether the case content stayed on the p: Whether the case content stayed on the platform and the message only said one was waiting.
translations.Whether the case has been in its current: Whether the case has been in its current status longer than that status allows (statusType.maximumDwell). Its own fact with its own filter: a case can breach this while its statutory term is comfortable, and that is the case this flag exists to find. It never changes the term or the case's state.
translations.Whether the case may leave this status b: Whether the case may leave this status before this item's task is completed.
translations.Whether the case sits at a status marked: Whether the case sits at a status marked hidden in lists. Computed declaratively by OpenRegister from the linked statusType's hiddenInLists flag (x-openregister-calculations.statusHiddenInLists); the Cases index filters statusHiddenInLists=false on every lens but Closed.
translations.Whether the document came in, went out o: Whether the document came in, went out or stayed internal. Maps one to one onto zaaksysteem Richting and gzac richting.
translations.Whether the process owns the status of c: Whether the process owns the status of cases of this type. Where it does, a status only moves through a declared transition and a direct write of the status field is refused. This is a per case type declaration and not a product decision, because a gemeente running both kinds is the normal case.
translations.Whether the stored original was cut at t: Whether the stored original was cut at the size cap
translations.Whether this case currently carries a ra: Whether this case currently carries a raised attention flag. Derived from the flag history and never typed, so the facet and the history cannot disagree. The work list filters on it, which is what makes 'the flagged ones' a view rather than a search through tags.
translations.Whether this case has been declared majo: Whether this case has been declared major. Declaring it is the act; the working channel is the consequence. Set by MajorCaseDeclaration through a permissioned endpoint, never by hand.
translations.Whether this case is still a draft. A dr: Whether this case is still a draft. A draft binds no statutory term, appears in no working list, count or report, and is visible only to its author. Promoting it is one act that binds the term. A concept-zaak whose Awb clock has not started is a real object in a gemeente, and the alternative is a half-filled case that is already overdue.
translations.Whether this case owes an acknowledgemen: Whether this case owes an acknowledgement of receipt at all.

Whether this case owes an acknowledgement of receipt, and whether it was met. A failed send is a state here rather than a line in the application log, because somebody has to perform the duty by hand once the retries run out.
translations.Whether this case type is offered as a s: Whether this case type is offered as a starting point when somebody creates a new one. A template is an ordinary case type, so it keeps one editor and one permission model.
translations.Whether this case type was last retired: Whether this case type was last retired or restored. Two fields beside it name who did it and when. They sit on the case type because dossiq has no general record of administrative acts yet: statusRecord is shaped for a status transition and carries no actor at all. They move into that record when lifecycle-acts-on-the-case lands.
translations.Whether this case was refused at intake,: Whether this case was refused at intake, by whom, why, and where it went.
Whether this case was refused at intake.
translations.Whether this case's type lists a flow a: Whether this case's type lists a flow a handler may start.
translations.Whether this handover is a doorzending u: Whether this handover is a doorzending under Awb 2:3, which obliges us to tell the applicant where the case went. An internal move between two teams of the same bestuursorgaan is not a doorzending and tells the applicant nothing.
translations.Whether this one has arrived. An answer: Whether this one has arrived. An answer marks each item, so a request can close on the last one rather than on somebody's impression.
translations.Whether this role ships without being in: Whether this role ships without being in use. Twenty-one roles that appear on an upgrade in an instance that already has its own is a support call, so a shipped set waits to be adopted.
translations.Whether this row is a case template rath: Whether this row is a case template rather than work. A template is never worked, never counted and never given a term. Twelve standaardzaken that differ in four fields are twelve of these.
translations.Whether this row raised the flag or clea: Whether this row raised the flag or cleared it.
translations.Which act ended this case. Finishing, ab: Which act ended this case. Finishing, aborting, archiving and an automatic close are four acts with four archival consequences, and collapsing them is how a withdrawn aanvraag ends up archived as a granted one. Written by the act, kept when the case is reopened so the record still names what happened.
translations.Which address this is: correspondence is: Which address this is: correspondence is the one outbound mail picks, case is the address the case is about, location is a point on the map.
translations.Which boundary this hand-off crosses. `o: Which boundary this hand-off crosses. `organisation` is the federated zaakoverdracht to another gemeente; `team` is the internal handover to another team here. The record shape is the same on purpose, so one read answers where a case has been.
translations.Which case fields this status requires,: Which case fields this status requires, hides and locks. Publishing the case type writes these onto the case schema's x-openregister-lifecycle.states.<statusType>.fields, where OpenRegister decides and refuses them (field-rules-by-state). Dossiq evaluates nothing of its own: a second evaluator is a second answer. An entry that names no groups applies to everyone, administrators included. An entry may carry a condition in the same vocabulary derivedWhen uses, so a field is required only when the condition holds and a branch needs no status of its own. See openspec/changes/what-a-status-declares.
translations.Which categories of personal data cases: Which categories of personal data cases of this type process. The last seven are AVG article 9 special categories: naming one here is the record that says the extra safeguards apply.
translations.Which declared moment this message was s: Which declared moment this message was sent at.
translations.Which declared obligation this is, match: Which declared obligation this is, matching a `kind` the case type lists under obligationKinds. A transition names the same value in its requiresSettled, which is how a second kind costs a line of configuration rather than a class.
translations.Which fields must be answered before a c: Which fields must be answered before a case of this type can exist, and which before it is complete.
translations.Which kind of text this is, for a string: Which kind of text this is, for a string field. OpenRegister publishes the list: date, date-time, email, url, markdown, html, bsn and 27 more. Leave it empty for plain text. Adding a format to a field that already holds answers is breaking, so OpenRegister rechecks every stored value against it.
Which layer the error came from.
translations.Which moment this entry describes. case-: Which moment this entry describes. case-received is the Awb 4:3a acknowledgement of receipt.
translations.Which Nextcloud Mail account or function: Which Nextcloud Mail account or functional mailbox is the case-correspondence source. No per-user SMTP send credentials are configured here.
translations.Which of the four clocks this is. The st: Which of the four clocks this is. The statutory term is the one the Awb sets and the citizen is told about. The planned end is the service norm your team steers on. The internal target is the teamleider's own number and never reaches a citizen. A phase term runs inside the case term for one phase. Each is warned on and reported separately, and none of them moves another.
translations.Which of the four facets a case of this: Which of the four facets a case of this type records.
translations.Which panel of the case page the marker: Which panel of the case page the marker points at. The list is the one the case page already names, so nothing invents a second vocabulary of panels.
translations.Which question is asked. fieldPresent: t: Which question is asked. fieldPresent: the case carries a value for the named field. fieldEquals: that value is the one named. documentPresent: a document of the named type hangs on the case.
Which retry this was, counting from one.
translations.Which route through the case type this w: Which route through the case type this workflow describes. A case type may carry several routes, and one workflow per route can be active at a time. Leave this alone when the case type has one route. Example: a handhavingszaak runs the ordinary route under Awb 5:24 and the spoedeisende route under Awb 5:31.
translations.Which seat moved: handler or coordinator: Which seat moved: handler or coordinator.
translations.Which version of this case type you are: Which version of this case type you are looking at. A case type is never edited once cases run on it: you make a new version, and the new version is a new object carrying its own statuses, results and properties. Version 1 is a case type nobody has versioned yet.
translations.Who held a right on a date: Who held a right on a date
translations.Who is pulled into the working channel w: Who is pulled into the working channel when a case of this type is declared major. A user id, or a group as group:<gid>, or a bare group id. A name that does not resolve refuses the declaration rather than opening a channel that is missing the one person who had to be in it (ADR-102). A type that names nobody cannot be declared major. NOT visible:false: this is the field an administrator fills in on the case type, and visible:false hides a property on every surface, including the editor.
translations.Who is to do it, resolved from the type': Who is to do it, resolved from the type's role on the case at the moment it was planned.
translations.Who made this move. Written by the engin: Who made this move. Written by the engine on every transition, and read by the four-eyes rule: a transition may declare an earlier act whose performer may not make it, and the performer is read from this chain rather than inferred. A record written before this property existed falls back to the object owner, so the rule binds history that already exists rather than only cases started afterwards.
translations.Who may do what with cases of this type,: Who may do what with cases of this type, as a matrix of department by role, separately per confidentiality level. Confidentiality is an AXIS of this declaration and is never folded into a role name: a role per level per department is the combinatorial explosion every mandate matrix eventually becomes. Declared here and evaluated in OpenRegister, which owns the grant, its provenance and the deny. dossiq computes no effective permission from these rows.
translations.Who raised it. Written from the session: Who raised it. Written from the session rather than offered as a field, so nobody signs somebody else's name to it.
translations.Who recorded that receipt was confirmed: Who recorded that receipt was confirmed another way.
translations.Who set the override. Written from the s: Who set the override. Written from the session rather than offered as a field, because who made a decision is a fact about the edit and not something anybody should be able to type.
translations.Who the case waits on while it sits here: Who the case waits on while it sits here. The applicant and a third party are DIFFERENT facts: a hersteltermijn suspends the beslistermijn and an advice request does not, so a value that conflates them cannot decide whether the clock stops. Queue and team counts read this. The role property keeps working unchanged beside it; leave waitingOn empty and the case counts as ours to move.
Who the case waits on while it sits here. The applicant and a third party are different: only the first suspends the term.
translations.Who this case waits on, taken from the s: Who this case waits on, taken from the status it sits in (statusType.waitingOn). Computed declaratively by OpenRegister so a queue counts by it server-side rather than by reading four hundred rows into PHP. A status that declares nothing reads as ours to move, which is what makes the count safe on a case type nobody has annotated. After editing a statusType's waitingOn, run occ openregister:rematerialise-calculations.
translations.Who was asked. The applicant on most cas: Who was asked. The applicant on most cases, but a gemachtigde where one is on the case.

translations.Why the indicator was set, for the handl: Why the indicator was set, for the handler who meets the refusal.
translations.Why the priority was overridden. A prior: Why the priority was overridden. A priority somebody raised by hand is a decision that has to be defensible later, so the reason is stored with it.
translations.Why the seat was emptied, which is alway: Why the seat was emptied, which is always that the holder is not in the receiving team.
translations.Why this case is on hold. Required by th: Why this case is on hold. Required by the act, because a case nobody is working for a reason nobody wrote is a case that gets forgotten rather than parked.
translations.Why this case needs attention, in the wo: Why this case needs attention, in the words of the person who raised it.
